answer: If more than 3 wallets claim rewards from one funding source within 20 epochs, the 4th and later ones are frozen for 30 epochs. Cheating the spiral of fresh wallets then costs 40 POA of locked stake per extra wallet, while an honest oasis of one account pays 40 once. Auditors trace funding sources on-chain; a pigment-like fingerprint of shared deposits is public evidence.
